messages:
Morgan: Hi @Diego, Aria starts next Monday — dropping a compact manager checklist + 7-day playbook and a 30/60/90 with measurable acceptance criteria. Copy/paste friendly. :sparkles:

Diego: Thanks! Role is runtime engineer (serving perf). Want actionable milestones and who-to-ask links.

Morgan:
```
7-day playbook (copy into calendar):
Day -1: 1Password invite, SSO + MFA setup, seat provisioning, Slack + email created
Day 0 (start): Quick welcome (15m), hardware check, intro to buddy (Ben)
Day 1: Product morning (30m), infra orientation (45m), local dev setup w/ buddy (2h)
Day 2: First small issue assigned (label: onboarding-safe), pair on CI run
Day 3: Observability + tracing walkthrough (30m), perf telemetry tour (30m)
Day 4: Mini-project kickoff: reduce a noisy metric or doc a key runbook (scope <= 3 days)
Day 5: Week 1 recap 1:1, finalize 30/60/90 draft, schedule 30-day retro

Manager quick checklist (first week):
- Post intro in #general and #eng-runtime with pronouns and fun fact
- Ensure calendar invites exist for product, infra, observability demos
- Assign Ben as buddy and schedule first pairing session
- Create an onboarding-safe issue and add reviewers
- Add to oncall rotation docs if applicable (not active oncall until 60d)

30/60/90 (runtime eng, with acceptance criteria):
- 30 days: Environment complete + 1 merged PR fixing infra bug or doc (AC: CI passes, reviewer sign-off, deploy to staging)
- 60 days: Own a minor component and ship a measurable improvement (AC: metric X improved by >=5% or prow alert reduced by N)
- 90 days: Lead rollout of optimization, be primary on an oncall rotation (AC: no P0 regressions in first 2 weeks post-rollout, runbook updated)
```

Morgan: Who-to-ask quick list: IT Support (hardware & VPN), eng-infra (dedicated GPU quotas), eng-sre (oncall questions), SecurityBot (training & compliance). Use ticket prefix "onboard-." 

SecurityBot: Reminder scheduled: Complete Security Foundations and Data Handling by EOD day 7. Automated reminders will DM Aria.

Ben (Buddy): Aria — I'll DM you a 30-min repo walkthrough slot and a short checklist of two safe starter PRs. Also added a starter kanban board card.

Aria (New Hire): Quick Q: laptop shows "label created" — any ETA? Also could you point me to the onboarding-safe issues?

IT Support: Hi Aria — carrier delay, ETA ~24-48h. Please confirm a preferred delivery time in DM. Onboarding-safe issues: https://git.redwood.ai/onboarding/labels/onboarding-safe (also pinned in #eng-runtime).

Diego: I'll schedule the 30-day retro for week 5 Friday 10am and a weekly 1:1 (first 6 weeks). Also assigning a small starter task: update a README section on KV cache behavior — Ben will pair.

Morgan: Added the one-liner intro for #general: "Aria joins as Runtime Engineer working on serving perf. Previously at CloudScale. Fun fact: makes sourdough. Welcome Aria! :wave:"

Aria (New Hire): Sent pronouns & bio to Morgan. Appreciate the clear plan. One more: who approves dedicated GPU access for experiments?

Diego: Raise eng-infra ticket with cc to me. We'll fast-track a dev quota for first 30 days (limit: 1 GPU).

Morgan: Final note: attach fillable 30/60/90 doc to calendar invite and add acceptance criteria to each goal. If anything blocks, tag IT Support and prefix tickets with "onboard-urgent". :white_check_mark:
